mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate rises and employment falls simultaneously (UNRATE > 0.2pp increase in 3 months and PAYEMS > 100k decline in 3 months), it signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 100k in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle housing bust regime (HOUST < 1600 and RSAFS < 650000), housing market collapse leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1600 and RSAFS < 650000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (the 2017 base year) indicates a healthy economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL above 285 signals high inflation that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 285, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) are both declining, it signals a housing market collapse that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment and falling employment regime (UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS < 150000), labor market deterioration leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS < 150000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
